announce_list.content:
Dear Linkers,
Anchor Panic is now available! Thank you for your patience and support! Welcome to Taino Star, a world of Eternal Night!

Humanity rebuilt behind protective Skyborne Barriers and created enhanced soldiers called Operators using AIMBS technology. Though the war ended, global powers now fracture from within, and a new crisis threatens to unravel a fragile peace. The fate of the world once again hangs in balance. You, as a linker, collide with singular girls and find out the truth of the world.

For those who participated in the Closed Beta Test, please check your mail box and claim the special rewards by redeeming the codes. Thank you for always supporting us!

Please refer to the Game Announcement and official community for more information and details.

Best regards,
Anchor Panic Official

announce_list.title: Game Introduction

announce_list.content:
Dear Linkers,
We greatly appreciate your support for maintaining a secure and equitable gaming environment. Ensuring fair play is fundamental to our mission, and we strictly prohibit any form of cheating or harmful conduct. We encourage all participants to adhere to established rules and contribute positively to the community.

Violations of our terms of service, including exploitation of gameplay systems, will lead to disciplinary actions. These may involve removal of in-game assets, temporary suspension of account access, or permanent termination of the account.

Play Honestly:
Unauthorized modification of game software or data is strictly forbidden. This includes using automation tools, exploits, or any other methods that grant unfair advantages. Such programs often compromise account security and privacy.

Secure Your Account:
The acquisition, sale, or transfer of game accounts violates our terms of service. These activities significantly increase the risk of fraudulent access and irreversible account loss. Please note that we cannot ensure the protection of accounts that have been shared or transferred between users.

Make Safe Purchases:
Always use our official channels for all transactions. Be cautious of unauthorized vendors offering discounted currency or items, as they often require your personal login details and may lead to account compromise or financial loss. Acquiring in-game resources through non-official means can result in their revocation and potential account sanctions.

Foster a Respectful Community:
We expect everyone to interact with kindness and respect. Harassment, discrimination, hate speech, disclosure of private information, or defamatory behavior will not be tolerated and may result in permanent account termination.

We are dedicated to creating engaging experiences and believe that integrity and respectful interaction are essential for a thriving game community.
announce_list.name: Fair Play
announce_list.title: Fair Play Announcement

announce_list.content:
Dear Linkers,
To ensure the safety of your account and game assets, we strongly advise against purchasing, selling, renting, or engaging in any form of game account transactions through unauthorized third-party platforms. These actions pose significant security risks, including potential fraud, account lost, and financial loss.

Please note that if your account encounters any issues as a result of such unauthorized transactions, our official support team will be unable to provide any customer service assistance. Furthermore, these activities are direct violations of our game's terms of service and may lead to permanent suspension of your account.

​We recommend only using official channels for all your game-related activities to protect your account and enjoy a fair gaming environment.
